title: Invertible pullback has image in the locally invertible open
statement: Let $W$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $M,N$ be finite locally free $\mathcal O_W$-modules [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], and let $\varphi:M\to N$. For a morphism $h:T\to W$ of schemes, if the tensor pullback $h^*\varphi$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is an isomorphism, then the topological image of $h$ is contained in the locally invertible open $U_\varphi$ [def-sc-module-map-iso-locus].

source.place: Lemma 10.79.4(3), matrix proof; Tag 0095, tensor pullback on matrices

proof.text: For each t of T, map the given tensor pullback isomorphism through the module stalk functor at t. Transport invertibility across the natural pullback-stalk comparison by NatIso.isIso_map_iff.
The extended original stalk map is invertible. Reflection along the local scheme stalk map makes the original map invertible at h(t).
Extend the stalk inverse to an open neighbourhood U of h(t). The membership criterion for moduleMapIsoLocus inserts h(t) into the union of invertible opens. Every point in range h has this form.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 10.79.4(3), via stalk scalar-extension reflection and inverse spreading; Tag 0098 supplies the natural tensor-pullback stalk comparison. Lean assembly written by S1.
